brief: [draft] wages nobody collected, sitting where they were left
description: [draft] a tin box of wages for a shift that never clocked out

brief: [draft] a pocket of garnets, freed from the rock
description: [draft] small dark stones, cut and pocketed by somebody in a hurry

brief: A gold assay button sits here, small and entirely sure of itself.
description: A bead of refined gold no bigger than a waistcoat button — the honest leavings of an honest assay. Gold does not tarnish, and it has not bothered to start.

brief: [draft] a stopped watch, on the foreman
description: [draft] a pocket watch, stopped at the hour it happened

brief: [draft] a sheet of native silver, freed from the wall
description: [draft] a sheet of native silver, heavier than a sheet has any right to be

brief: [draft] a nest of pearls, sitting in the pool
description: [draft] small stone pearls, rolled round by water with nowhere better to be

brief: [draft] the nugget the town is named for, wedged in the rock
description: [draft] a nugget the size of a fist, and the reason the town has a name

brief: [draft] a cache someone hid and never came back for
description: [draft] a small hoard, packed by somebody who meant to return for it

brief: [draft] a bronze tool, sitting in its rack
description: [draft] a bronze tool, worn smooth by a grip that was not shaped like yours

brief: [draft] a plate cut with marks, counting something
description: [draft] a plate of marks, cut deep, counting something the narrator will not name

brief: [draft] a stone that has no business being warm
description: [draft] a stone, warm to the hand, for no reason anyone has found

brief: [draft] the thing the seal was built for
description: [draft] the thing the seal was built to keep, and now it is in your hands

brief: Your brass lantern sits here, which is rarely where it should be.
description: Dented brass, clean glass, an honest wick. It is the only opinion you carry that the dark is known to respect.

brief: [draft] an oil flask, left for whoever needs it
description: [draft] a flask of lamp oil, the game's one margin against the dark

brief: A caged canary is here, watching you professionally.
description: A tin cage and a yellow bird with the alert look of a good employee. Canaries went below so the miners would know what the air was doing before it did it to them. This one knows the work, according to the man who has yet to be paid for it.

brief: A small brass key lies here, out of work.
description: Brass, small, well made, with ASSAY stamped on the bow. Somebody oiled it before hanging it up for the last time, which is the kind of thing this town does.

brief: [draft] a key, turned up where it was hidden
description: [draft] a small iron key for the magazine door

brief: [draft] a steel gad, left with the tack
description: [draft] a steel gad, made for prying what does not want to move

brief: [draft] a pump handle, missing its pump
description: [draft] a cast handle, sized for the pump in the room to the north

brief: [draft] a keg of powder, labelled in someone's careful hand
description: [draft] a keg of blasting powder, labelled NOT WITHOUT A FUSE in a careful hand

brief: [draft] a coil of fuse, beside the keg
description: [draft] a coil of slow fuse, exactly as long as somebody thought it should be

brief: [draft] the foreman's tally book
description: [draft] a book of counts, kept in a hand that stopped keeping it
readText: [draft] Among the counts, one word is written twice and underlined: GUNNIS.

brief: [draft] the assay office's ledger
description: [draft] a ledger of everything the office ever weighed, and one thing it never did

brief: The assay office door stands on the east corner, taking its lock seriously.
description: A good door with a better lock. The keyhole's polish says it was turned twice a day for years, and then not at all.

brief: [draft] the magazine door, shut fast
description: [draft] a heavy door, locked the way a powder magazine's door ought to be

brief: [draft] the great pump, seized and silent
description: [draft] a pump the size of a room, seized, and missing its handle

brief: [draft] a stull you could pull, if you were willing
description: [draft] a single stout timber, set to hold back exactly what you would expect

brief: [draft] a fall of rubble, new and unsettled
description: [draft] loose rock, freshly come down, and not yet decided about staying that way

brief: [draft] the foreman, still at his post
description: [draft] a man who did not leave when the others did, and has not moved since

brief: [draft] the foreman's desk, drawers shut
description: [draft] a desk of dark wood, its drawers shut on whatever he left in them

brief: The assay bench runs along the wall, dust keeping the ledger now.
description: Built stout, for weighing small heavy things. The dust lies even and undisturbed across the top — except along the seam at the wall, where it isn't.

brief: [draft] stacks of plates, waiting to be read
description: [draft] plates stacked chest high, each one cut with marks nobody has read in years

brief: [draft] a stull scratched with a word
description: [draft] a stull scratched waist high with a word, plain as a signature

brief: [draft] the throat of the ore chute, open and waiting
description: [draft] a chute throat that has been waiting ninety years for one more careless thing

brief: [draft] a bare seam of something pale in the rock
description: [draft] a seam of native silver showing bare in the rock, easy to reach and hard to free quietly

brief: [draft] a pothole with something wedged in it
description: [draft] a pothole worn round by the river, with something wedged fast in the bottom

brief: [draft] the mechanism, waiting for a grip that is not yours
description: [draft] a locking mechanism with slots cut for a grip that is not shaped like a hand
